title: The Impossible Letters
author: A. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Jonah Vasquez, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
